taglines: June 3rd. The sprint ends Friday. The sprint has ended on Friday every two weeks for two years. Nothing has ever been done by Friday.
You merged to main without a PR. Bold. Chaotic. Deeply personal.
The bug is not in your code. The bug is in your understanding of reality. Same difference.
Someone asked if this is documented. I laughed for several minutes. We are doing fine.
Hot take: the codebase is not legacy, it is experienced. It has seen things you cannot imagine.
'Let's just do a quick refactor.' — last words of many a Wednesday afternoon.
The environment is production. The environment has always been production. Stop asking.
I have been running for 9:00 AM on a Wednesday and I already feel like a Thursday at 4:57 PM.
